macros.name: pbox
macros.doc: The \pbox command is equivalent to the \parbox command, only the width specified is merely the maximum width; the \pbox tries to fit itself tightly around the specified text.

macros.name: widthofpbox
macros.doc: \widthofpbox{text} returns the width of the multi-line text.
